select T.subjectNo, T.balFlag, SUM(T.TdyOCAmt) as TdyOCAmt, SUM(T.TdyODAmt) as TdyODAmt, SUM(TT.TdyOCoCAmt) as TdyOCoCAmt, SUM(TT.TdyOCoDAmt) as TdyOCoDAmt from (select subjectNo,balFlag,SUM(TdyOCAmt) TdyOCAmt,SUM(TdyODAmt) TdyODAmt from (
select decode(bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL, '3', CASE WHEN bb.FSUBJECT_NO IN ('611110','611130','611102','611103','611104') THEN bb.subject_no ELSE bb.FSUBJECT_NO END , bb.subject_no) as subjectNo, /*科目号*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(bb.TDY_O_C_AMT, 0) as TdyOCAmt, /*原币余额*/ NVL(bb.TDY_O_D_AMT, 0) as TdyODAmt /*原币余额借方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb where bb.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and bb.SUBJECT_NO like '6%' or bb.SUBJECT_NO like '3%' and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')>=#{vdate} and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{mdate} )GROUP BY subjectNo,balFlag)T
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT subjectNo,balFlag,SUM(NVL(TdyOCoCAmt,0)) TdyOCoCAmt,SUM(NVL(TdyOCoDAmt,0)) TdyOCoDAmt FROM ( select decode(bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL, '3', CASE WHEN bb.FSUBJECT_NO IN ('611110','611130','611102','611103','611104') THEN bb.subject_no ELSE bb.FSUBJECT_NO END , bb.subject_no) as subjectNo, /*科目号*/
bb.BALANCE_DATE as balanceDate, /*余额日期*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(TDY_O_CO_C_AMT, 0) as TdyOCoCAmt, /*原币余额贷方*/ NVL(TDY_O_CO_D_AMT, 0) as TdyOCoDAmt /*原币余额贷方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb where bb.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and bb.SUBJECT_NO like '6%' or bb.SUBJECT_NO like '3%' and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')>=#{sdate} and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{mdate}) GROUP BY subjectNo,balFlag) TT ON T.subjectNo=TT.subjectNo AND T.balFlag = TT.balFlag group by T.subjectNo, T.balFlag

select T.subjectNo, T.balFlag, SUM(T.TdyBCAmt) as TdyBCAmt, SUM(T.TdyBDAmt) as TdyBDAmt, SUM(TT.TdyBCoCAmt) as TdyBCoCAmt, SUM(TT.TdyBCoDAmt) as TdyBCoDAmt from (select subjectNo,balFlag,SUM(TdyBCAmt) TdyBCAmt,SUM(TdyBDAmt) TdyBDAmt from (
select decode(bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL, '3', CASE WHEN bb.FSUBJECT_NO IN ('611110','611130','611102','611103','611104') THEN bb.subject_no ELSE bb.FSUBJECT_NO END , bb.subject_no) as subjectNo, /*科目号*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(bb.TDY_B_C_AMT, 0) as TdyBCAmt, /*本币余额*/ NVL(bb.TDY_B_D_AMT, 0) as TdyBDAmt /*本币余额借方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb where bb.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and bb.SUBJECT_NO like '6%' or bb.SUBJECT_NO like '3%' and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')>=#{vdate} and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{mdate} )GROUP BY subjectNo,balFlag)T
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT subjectNo,balFlag,SUM(NVL(TdyBCoCAmt,0)) TdyBCoCAmt,SUM(NVL(TdyBCoDAmt,0)) TdyBCoDAmt FROM ( select decode(bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL, '3', CASE WHEN bb.FSUBJECT_NO IN ('611110','611130','611102','611103','611104') THEN bb.subject_no ELSE bb.FSUBJECT_NO END , bb.subject_no) as subjectNo, /*科目号*/
bb.BALANCE_DATE as balanceDate, /*余额日期*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(TDY_B_CO_C_AMT, 0) as TdyBCoCAmt, /*原币余额贷方*/ NVL(TDY_B_CO_D_AMT, 0) as TdyBCoDAmt /*原币余额贷方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb where bb.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and bb.SUBJECT_NO like '6%' or bb.SUBJECT_NO like '3%' and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')>=#{sdate} and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{mdate}) GROUP BY subjectNo,balFlag) TT ON T.subjectNo=TT.subjectNo AND T.balFlag = TT.balFlag group by T.subjectNo, T.balFlag

select bb.subject_no as subjectNo, /*科目号*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ sum(NVL(bb.TDY_B_C_AMT, 0)) as TdyBCAmt, /*本币余额*/ sum(NVL(bb.TDY_B_D_AMT, 0)) as TdyBDAmt, /*本币余额借方*/ sum(NVL(TDY_B_CO_C_AMT, 0)) as TdyBCoCAmt, /*原币余额贷方*/ sum(NVL(TDY_B_CO_D_AMT, 0)) as TdyBCoDAmt /*原币余额贷方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb where bb.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and bb.SUBJECT_NO like '6%' and (bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL='1' or bb.SUBJECT_LEVEL='2') and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')>=#{vdate} and to_char(bb.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{mdate} group by bb.subject_no,bb.bal_flag
